about_the_game:
Jungle Shadow is an action-adventure game where you play as a sneaky, but agile Jungle Warrior named Simra that can be ruthless. She is self-trained living and breathing with her sharp blade and mystical red-violet hair in the gigantic Jungle of Platoshira. Prepare for a long adventure of threatening enemies ahead, difficult lengths of survival, vine movements and stealth moments like being behind the tall plants to avoid getting caught, which being caught will lead to massive amounts of danger. You are in the world's most dangerous Jungle as scientists try to uncover the deadly mist that reveals what the Jungle is exactly, how long it existed and what it holds within.

  • Inside the Jungle, Platoshira, you will explore the three large levels of the Jungle where as you go deeper, the more challenging it becomes. You can create two other weapons where it will be used at the right timings of a fight to give you a slight advantage of defeating the dangerous enemy. The reason Simra explores is to gain experience in upgrading and strengthening herself because she was born to be agile and like a beast that never sleeps. Noise builds within her head at times even within the shadows of just sleeping in the corner in the Jungle.

  • Platoshira is one of the most dangerous Jungles because there is a deadly fog surrounding the jungle and it could've been there for ages, unsolved, so a certain group of scientists were paid to investigate this Jungle by the government as it can make them a tremendous amount of money, great research and a story for everyone if successful. They don’t realise the danger inside the Jungle once entered in and they will need to have greater firepower.

Slashly and Punchy Combat: Swift through and use some parts of the environment to your advantage to slay your enemy with your sharp blade to boost damage. Failing won't be a viable option to your journey in Platoshira. Additionally, you will sometimes automatically activate finishers on enemies, but more might come back for revenge when returning to that location with slightly more health. 

Smooth and Swifty Movement: Mastering speed and jump power can work by sprinting in the game and you will be able to avoid deadly attack from frogs or other enemies.

Traversal System: In some cases, you'll have to use the vines to progress through the land of Platoshira and sometimes with danger below e.g. traps underneath, so avoiding that is survival otherwise it is instant defeat to yourself and your adventure ahead. You can also use small narrow entrances to get to the same location, but without a hassle of a fight, so this can be effective.

🔝XP & Levelling Up: Gain strength in the land of Platoshira by cutting up certain plants that drop glowing orbs with different colours equating to different amounts of XP. You can also later on unlock a few areas in different levels. Bash through these rocks with higher levels to unlock that specific area of the Jungle. Rare instances of coconuts where you break and gain one level up and even sometimes defeating enemies can bring XP.

Wipe fallen enemies' blood on trees as checkpoints: You will place your hand on small amounts of blood of fallen enemies and wipe it on a tree to create a checkpoint as your scent of blood is strong like iron.

Knife Throwing: Unlock this skill as you reach a certain level. Throw those knives from a distance from the enemy and pain will be inflicted to take out enemies faster.

Small Inventory & Crafting System: There will be certain pockets within objects like trees or rocks where you can store some items gained throughout your journey and it will be kept there until picked up. Crafting can be used to make traps for enemies and maybe even specific bosses.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 or AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750, 1GB or AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050, 1GB or AMD RTX 570
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Jungle Shadow is an action-adventure game set in the world's most dangerous Jungle — Platoshira. Explore to uncover your story, your world and what danger lies. Meanwhile, scientists slowly uncover the Jungle with their advanced technology and AI. Live to see your story unfold.
